proofs.text: Call for the project root from a directory with no `.purlin/` marker in it or in any ancestor; verify it returns the working directory

reasons: PROOF-3 happy_path_only: No proof of this rule names a rejection, an error or a boundary.
rule_text: Failing both, the root is the working directory

tests.body:
def test_falls_back_to_cwd(self):
        bare = os.path.join(self.tmpdir, 'no_marker')
        os.makedirs(bare)
        result = find_project_root(start_dir=bare)
        assert result == os.path.abspath(os.getcwd())
